detail.longDescription:
Meta launches Muse personal AI agent in the UK. Meta launched Muse in the UK, available on iOS, Android, web, and WhatsApp for users aged 18 and over. Muse is powered by Muse Spark, the first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, built for agentic tasks.
https://digestai.news/story/meta-launches-muse-assistant-in-uk-for-christmas-shopping?utm_source=bluesky&utm_medium=social
